# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_l3hw_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `autorestart` (Boolean) Automatically restarts the l3hw driver in case of an error.
- `fasttrack_hw` (Boolean) Enables or disables FastTrack hardware offloading.
- `icmp_reply_on_error` (Boolean) Since the hardware cannot send ICMP messages, the packet must be redirected to the CPU. Disabling this option stops the router from generating ICMP errors for hardware offloaded traffic.
- `ipv6_hw` (Boolean) Enables or disables IPv6 hardware offloading.

### Read-Only

- `hw_supports_fasttrack` (Boolean) Indicates if the hardware (switch chip) supports FastTrack hardware offloading.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
